dedupe_keys.name: turkiye deposit system for packaging doa early national implementation data july to september 2026

description: This dataset records the first weeks of Türkiye's national Deposit System for Packaging (Depozito Yönetim Sistemi, DOA), which pays a refund for returned beverage packaging. It was compiled by Muhammed Yunus Bilgili and published on Mendeley Data in September 2026. It gives the cumulative number of packaging units collected and of registered users at selected dates between 1 July 2026, when the system expanded to all 81 provinces and the refund rose from 0.25 to 1 Turkish lira, and 5 September 2026; by the end of the 67 days about 205.7 million units had been collected and 3.2 million users registered, with collection growing faster than participation. It also lists the official sources used. Coverage is national. The files are free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the author warns that the figures are descriptive, cannot separate the effect of the higher refund from the wider return network, and do not show what would have happened to the packaging otherwise; figures come from official announcements. Simulation uses: uptake curves for return-based collection systems in waste service and material flow models. Related records: the Italian municipal waste cost panel (data-italy-municipal-solid-waste-cost-panel) and the Portuguese food waste collection strategies (data-dataset-in-municipal-strategies-for-food-waste-collection-in-portugal-p02995) describe other collection schemes.
